result.title: BatchParScale: Sparse Batch-Mixing for Sequence Models
result.summary: Recent test-time scaling methods improve model performance by increasing inference-time compute. One practical form of this is parallel scaling, where a model samples multiple independent reasoning streams and aggregates their answers using methods like voting, reranking, or verification. While effective, this approach leaves the streams uncoordinated, and a discovery made in one rollout cannot influence any other. Multi-Sequence Verifiers jointly score candidate answers after generation, but the reasoning streams remain independent during inference. ParScale takes a step toward model-internal parallel scaling by learning to aggregate multiple forward passes, but its streams still do not exchange information while processing a sequence. We introduce BatchParScale, an attention mechanism that allows parallel streams to exchange information through a small set of communication positions. We evaluate BatchParScale on a new Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval benchmark and in pretraining, fine-tuning, and cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning. Across these settings, BatchParScale outperforms ParScale on language-model loss and remains competitive on coordination-sensitive MARL tasks. Masked pretraining runs beat an unmasked single-sequence baseline despite local sequence corruption, and LoRA fine-tuning shows the mechanism can be added to a pretrained Transformer. At the same time, fact retrieval performance for pretrained and finetuned BatchParScale models remains unclear.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BatchParScale，一种在 batch 内多条并行序列流之间通过少量「通信位置」交换信息的注意力机制，用于并行测试时扩展，并在自建的 Parallel Needle-in-a-Haystack 检索基准、预训练、LoRA 微调与协作式多智能体强化学习中与 ParScale 及单序列基线比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 关注的「parallel 方式如何产生与更新推理状态」直接相关：多流在解码过程中经稀疏通信位置互通信息，可能为多条 latent 推理轨迹的协同、聚合与信息坍缩问题提供方法线索；但属纯文本序列模型、事实检索效果作者自述尚不明确，可否迁移到多模态推理可供核查。
